source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Unit 8 (PDF 145-174), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 8 (Mathematical Induction and Binomial Theorem) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Prove by mathematical induction that \(1 \cdot 2 + 2 \cdot 3 + 3 \cdot 4 + \ldots + n(n + 1) = \frac{n(n + 1)(n + 2)}{3}\) for every positive integer \(n\). (5 marks)
(Mathematical induction se sabit karein ke har musbat integer \(n\) ke liye \(1 \cdot 2 + 2 \cdot 3 + \ldots + n(n + 1) = \frac{n(n + 1)(n + 2)}{3}\).)
blocks.explanation: Base case \(n = 1\); \(S(k)\) ko (A) farz karein, agli term \((k + 1)(k + 2)\) jama karein aur \((k + 1)(k + 2)\) common lein.

book_ref.quote: A good way to write every induction proof for a sum:

steps: Dono sharten poori, is liye induction se \(S(n)\) har musbat integer ke liye sach.
blocks.final_answer: Sabit hua: \(1 \cdot 2 + 2 \cdot 3 + \ldots + n(n + 1) = \frac{n(n + 1)(n + 2)}{3}\) har musbat integer \(n\) ke liye.

blocks.prompt:
2 Prove by mathematical induction that \(1^{3} + 2^{3} + 3^{3} + \ldots + n^{3} = \left[\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\right]^{2}\) for every positive integer \(n\). (5 marks)
(Induction se sabit karein ke \(1^{3} + 2^{3} + \ldots + n^{3} = \left[\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\right]^{2}\) har musbat integer \(n\) ke liye.)
blocks.explanation: \((k + 1)^{3}\) jama karein aur \(\frac{(k + 1)^{2}}{4}\) common lein; bracket poora murabba ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Expanding everything into a big polynomial instead of taking the common factor

steps: Induction se formula har musbat integer ke liye sach.
blocks.final_answer: Sabit hua: \(1^{3} + 2^{3} + \ldots + n^{3} = \left[\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\right]^{2}\) tamam \(n \in \mathbb{N}\) ke liye.

blocks.prompt:
3 Prove by mathematical induction that \(11^{n} - 6\) is divisible by 5 for every \(n \in \mathbb{N}\). (5 marks)
(Induction se sabit karein ke har \(n \in \mathbb{N}\) ke liye \(11^{n} - 6\) 5 se divisible hai.)
blocks.explanation: Hypothesis ko \(11^{k} - 6 = 5m\) likhein, \(11^{k + 1}\) ko \(11^{k}\) se likh kar substitute karein.

book_ref.quote: so we write the assumption as an equation and substitute it into

steps: Is liye \(S(k)\) se \(S(k + 1)\); base case ke saath statement tamam \(n\) ke liye sach.
blocks.final_answer: Sabit hua: \(11^{n} - 6\) har \(n \in \mathbb{N}\) ke liye 5 se divisible hai.

blocks.prompt:
4 Prove by mathematical induction that \(3^{2n} - 1\) is divisible by 8 for every \(n \in \mathbb{N}\). (5 marks)
(Induction se sabit karein ke \(3^{2n} - 1\) har \(n \in \mathbb{N}\) ke liye 8 se divisible hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(3^{2(k + 1)} = 9 \cdot 3^{2k}\); hypothesis se \(3^{2k} = 8m + 1\) rakhein.

book_ref.quote: Method: induction. "Divisible by 9" means

steps: Dono sharten poori; induction se natija sach.
blocks.final_answer: Sabit hua: \(3^{2n} - 1\) har \(n \in \mathbb{N}\) ke liye 8 se divisible.

blocks.prompt:
5 Prove by mathematical induction that \(4 + 4 \cdot 5 + 4 \cdot 5^{2} + \ldots + 4 \cdot 5^{n} = 5^{n + 1} - 1\) for every non-negative integer \(n\). (5 marks)
(Induction se sabit karein ke har ghair-manfi integer \(n\) ke liye \(4 + 4 \cdot 5 + \ldots + 4 \cdot 5^{n} = 5^{n + 1} - 1\).)
blocks.explanation: Statement \(n = 0\) se shuru hai, is liye base case \(S(0)\); phir \(4 \cdot 5^{k + 1}\) jama karein.

book_ref.quote: because the statement is claimed for

steps: Induction se formula har whole number ke liye sach.
blocks.final_answer: Sabit hua: \(4 + 4 \cdot 5 + \ldots + 4 \cdot 5^{n} = 5^{n + 1} - 1\) har \(n \in W\) ke liye.

blocks.prompt:
6 Prove by mathematical induction that \(\sum_{k=1}^{n} \frac{1}{(3k - 2)(3k + 1)} = \frac{n}{3n + 1}\) for every positive integer \(n\). (5 marks)
(Induction se sabit karein ke \(\sum_{k=1}^{n} \frac{1}{(3k - 2)(3k + 1)} = \frac{n}{3n + 1}\) har musbat integer \(n\) ke liye.)
blocks.explanation: Induction ke liye \(m\) istemal karein (\(k\) counter hai). \(k = m + 1\) wali term jama kar ke numerator ke factors banayein.

book_ref.quote: is already used as the counter inside the sum, so the book uses

steps: Is liye \(S(m) \Rightarrow S(m + 1)\); induction se natija sach.

blocks.prompt:
7 Prove that \(3^{n} > 2^{n} + 4\) for all integers \(n \ge 2\). (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke tamam integers \(n \ge 2\) ke liye \(3^{n} > 2^{n} + 4\).)
blocks.explanation: \(i = 2\) se extended induction: hypothesis ko 3 se zarb dein, right side ko yun torein ke \(2^{k + 1} + 4\) nazar aaye, baqi musbat hissa chhor dein.

book_ref.quote: For an inequality we multiply the hypothesis by a positive number and then compare.

steps: Base case \(n = 2\): \(9 > 8\). (\(n = 1\) par \(3 > 6\) ghalat, is liye 2 se shuru.)
Extended induction se tamam \(n \ge 2\) ke liye sach.
blocks.final_answer: Sabit hua: \(3^{n} > 2^{n} + 4\) tamam integers \(n \ge 2\) ke liye.

blocks.prompt:
8 Prove that \(2 + 4 + 6 + \ldots + (2n + 6) = (n + 3)(n + 4)\) for all integers \(n \ge -2\). (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke tamam integers \(n \ge -2\) ke liye \(2 + 4 + 6 + \ldots + (2n + 6) = (n + 3)(n + 4)\).)
blocks.explanation: \(i = -2\) ke saath extended induction; \(2k + 6\) ke baad agli term \(2k + 8\) hai.

book_ref.quote: The chain of dominoes now starts at domino number

steps: Base case \(n = -2\): aakhri term 2; left 2, right \((1)(2) = 2\).
Extended induction se tamam \(n \ge -2\) ke liye sach.

blocks.prompt:
9 Prove that \(2^{n} > 2n + 1\) for all integers \(n \ge 3\). (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke tamam integers \(n \ge 3\) ke liye \(2^{n} > 2n + 1\).)
blocks.explanation: \(i = 3\) se shuru; hypothesis ko 2 se zarb dein aur \(4k + 2\) ko \(2(k + 1) + 1\) jama musbat hissa likhein.

book_ref.quote: We may drop a positive part only from the smaller side

steps: Extended induction se tamam \(n \ge 3\) ke liye sach.
blocks.final_answer: Sabit hua: \(2^{n} > 2n + 1\) tamam integers \(n \ge 3\) ke liye.

blocks.prompt:
10 Bilal does 6 push-ups on the first day and each day he does 4 more than the day before. Prove by mathematical induction that the total number of push-ups in \(n\) days is \(2n^{2} + 4n\). (5 marks)
(Bilal pehle din 6 push-ups karta hai aur har din pichhle din se 4 zyada. Induction se sabit karein ke \(n\) dinon mein kul push-ups \(2n^{2} + 4n\) hain.)
blocks.explanation: Din \(d\) par \(6 + 4(d - 1)\); qadam mein \(k\) dinon ke kul mein din \(k + 1\) ke \(6 + 4k\) jama karein.

book_ref.quote: A real-life rule that adds (or removes) a fixed amount each step gives a formula in

steps: Induction se \(n\) dinon ka kul \(2n^{2} + 4n\) (maslan 3 din: 30).
blocks.final_answer: Sabit hua: \(n\) dinon mein kul push-ups \(2n^{2} + 4n\).

blocks.prompt:
11 Prove the binomial theorem \((a + x)^{n} = \sum_{r=0}^{n}\binom{n}{r}a^{n-r}x^{r}\) for every positive integer \(n\) by mathematical induction. (5 marks)
(Mathematical induction se binomial theorem \((a + x)^{n} = \sum_{r=0}^{n}\binom{n}{r}a^{n-r}x^{r}\) har musbat integer \(n\) ke liye sabit karein.)
blocks.explanation: Base case \(n = 1\); \(n = k\) wale case ko \((a + x)\) se zarb dein, milti julti terms jama karein aur Pascal ka qaida lagayein.

book_ref.quote: Now we prove the Binomial theorem for any positive integer

steps: (B) ko \((a + x)\) se zarb: \(a(a + x)^{k} + x(a + x)^{k}\). \(a^{k-r+1}x^{r}\) wali term \(\binom{k}{r}\) aur \(\binom{k}{r-1}\) dono se aati hai.
Yeh \(n = k + 1\) ki statement hai. Induction se theorem tamam musbat integers ke liye sach.
blocks.final_answer: Sabit hua: \((a + x)^{n} = \sum_{r=0}^{n}\binom{n}{r}a^{n-r}x^{r}\) har musbat integer \(n\) ke liye.

blocks.prompt:
12 Expand \(\left(2x - \frac{1}{x}\right)^{5}\) and find its general term. (5 marks)
(\(\left(2x - \frac{1}{x}\right)^{5}\) ko phelayein aur is ki general term nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehli term \(2x\), doosri \(-\frac{1}{x}\), \(n = 5\), chhe terms; signs baari baari badalte hain.

book_ref.quote: Dropping the minus sign of the second term

blocks.prompt:
13 In the expansion of \(\left(2x^{2} - \frac{1}{x}\right)^{9}\) find: (i) the term involving \(x^{6}\) (ii) the fourth term (iii) the coefficient of \(x^{-3}\). (5 marks)
(\(\left(2x^{2} - \frac{1}{x}\right)^{9}\) ke phelao mein nikalein: (i) \(x^{6}\) wali term (ii) chauthi term (iii) \(x^{-3}\) ka coefficient.)
blocks.explanation: General term aik dafa saada karein; phir \(x\) ki power ya term number se \(r\) chunein.

book_ref.quote: This is much faster than writing all 12 terms.

steps: \(x^{-3}\) ka coefficient \(-144\). (\(r\) jufat to musbat, taaq to manfi.)

blocks.prompt:
14 For the expansion of \(\left(x^{2} + \frac{1}{2x}\right)^{9}\) find (i) the term independent of \(x\) (ii) the middle terms. (5 marks)
(\(\left(x^{2} + \frac{1}{2x}\right)^{9}\) ke phelao ke liye nikalein: (i) \(x\) se azad term (ii) middle terms.)
blocks.explanation: \(T_{r+1}\) mein \(x\) ki aik power banayein; \(n = 9\) taaq hai, is liye do middle terms.

book_ref.quote: terms of the expansion will be the two middle terms

blocks.prompt:
15 For \(\left(x - \frac{3}{x}\right)^{8}\) find (i) the middle term (ii) the term involving \(x^{-4}\). (5 marks)
(\(\left(x - \frac{3}{x}\right)^{8}\) ke liye nikalein: (i) middle term (ii) \(x^{-4}\) wali term.)
blocks.explanation: \(n = 8\) jufat, aik middle term (\(r = 4\)); (ii) mein \(x\) ki power \(-4\) ke barabar rakhein.

book_ref.quote: will be the only one middle term in the expansion

blocks.prompt:
16 Prove that \(\binom{n}{0} + 2\binom{n}{1} + 3\binom{n}{2} + \ldots + (n + 1)\binom{n}{n} = (n + 2)2^{n-1}\). (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke \(\binom{n}{0} + 2\binom{n}{1} + 3\binom{n}{2} + \ldots + (n + 1)\binom{n}{n} = (n + 2)2^{n-1}\).)
blocks.explanation: Har multiplier \(r + 1\) ko \(r\) aur \(1\) mein torein; \(r\binom{n}{r} = n\binom{n-1}{r-1}\) aur coefficients ka majmua istemal karein.

book_ref.quote: and recognise the bracket as the sum of all the coefficients of

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yahan har coefficient ke saath \(r + 1\) zarb hai. Isay do hisson mein torna asaan hai: \(r\binom{n}{r}\) wala hissa Example 14 jaisa \(n \cdot 2^{n-1}\) deta hai, aur \(\binom{n}{r}\) wala hissa tamam coefficients ka majmua \(2^{n}\) hai.

blocks.prompt:
17 Prove that in the expansion of \((1 + x)^{n}\) the sum of the coefficients in the odd places equals the sum of those in the even places, and that each sum is \(2^{n-1}\). (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke \((1 + x)^{n}\) ke phelao mein taaq jagah (odd places) ke coefficients ka majmua jufat jagah wale coefficients ke majmue ke barabar hai, aur har aik \(2^{n-1}\) hai.)
blocks.explanation: \((1 + x)^{n}\) mein \(x = 1\) aur \(x = -1\) rakhein; dono natijon ko jama aur tafreeq karein.

book_ref.quote: Thus, sum of odd coefficients of a binomial expansion equals to the sum of its even coefficients.

blocks.prompt:
18 Find the general term in the expansion of \((1 + x)^{-4}\), \(|x| < 1\), and use it to write the first four terms. (5 marks)
(\((1 + x)^{-4}\), \(|x| < 1\), ki general term nikalein aur is se pehli chaar terms likhein.)
blocks.explanation: \(T_{r+1}\) mein \(n = -4\) rakhein, \((-1)^{r}\) bahar nikalein aur factorial poora karein.

book_ref.quote: take the minus signs out, and write the product with factorials so that it cancels

blocks.prompt:
19 Expand \((8 - 3x)^{1/3}\) up to four terms and state the values of \(x\) for which the expansion is valid. (5 marks)
(\((8 - 3x)^{1/3}\) ko chaar terms tak phelayein aur batayein ke kin values of \(x\) ke liye durust hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(8^{1/3} = 2\) bahar nikalein taake bracket 1 se shuru ho; phir \(n = \frac{1}{3}\) aur doosri term \(-\frac{3x}{8}\).

book_ref.quote: The first term must be 1. The form is

blocks.prompt:
20 Evaluate \(\sqrt[3]{126}\) correct to three places of decimals by the binomial theorem. (5 marks)
(Binomial theorem se \(\sqrt[3]{126}\) teen decimal tak nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: 125 qareeb tareen poora cube hai: \(126 = 125\left(1 + \frac{1}{125}\right)\); 5 bahar nikal kar \(n = \frac{1}{3}\) se phelayein.

book_ref.quote: Strategy for a root or power of a number

blocks.prompt:
21 If \(x\) is so small that its cube and higher powers can be neglected, show that \((1 + x)^{1/3}(1 - x)^{-2/3} \approx 1 + x + \frac{2}{3}x^{2}\). (5 marks)
(Agar \(x\) itna chhota ho ke \(x^{3}\) aur ooper ki powers chhor di jayen to dikhayein ke \((1 + x)^{1/3}(1 - x)^{-2/3} \approx 1 + x + \frac{2}{3}x^{2}\).)
blocks.explanation: Har bracket ko \(x^{2}\) tak phelayein, zarb dein, aur sirf \(x^{2}\) tak ki terms rakhein.

book_ref.quote: each multiply the second bracket

blocks.prompt:
22 If \(y = \frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{1}{3}\right) + \frac{1 \cdot 3}{2 \cdot 4}\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^{2} + \frac{1 \cdot 3 \cdot 5}{2 \cdot 4 \cdot 6}\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^{3} + \ldots\), prove that \(2y^{2} + 4y - 1 = 0\). (5 marks)
(Agar \(y = \frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{1}{3}\right) + \frac{1 \cdot 3}{2 \cdot 4}\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^{2} + \frac{1 \cdot 3 \cdot 5}{2 \cdot 4 \cdot 6}\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^{3} + \ldots\) ho to sabit karein ke \(2y^{2} + 4y - 1 = 0\).)
blocks.explanation: 1 jama karein taake series 1 se shuru ho, 2nd aur 3rd terms ko \(nx\) aur \(\frac{n(n-1)}{2!}x^{2}\) se milayein, phir \(1 + y = (1 + x)^{n}\).

book_ref.quote: forgetting to add 1 to both sides before comparing

steps: \(1 + y\) ki series ko \(1 + nx + \frac{n(n-1)}{2!}x^{2} + \ldots\) se milayein.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Series ko pehchanne ke liye pehle 1 jama karein, kyunke binomial series hamesha 1 se shuru hoti hai. Phir sirf doosri aur teesri term se do equations bana kar \(n\) aur \(x\) nikalte hain; chauthi term se check kar lein ke sahi pehchana.

blocks.prompt:
23 Use the binomial theorem to show that \(1 + \frac{1}{3}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) + \frac{1 \cdot 4}{3 \cdot 6}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{2} + \frac{1 \cdot 4 \cdot 7}{3 \cdot 6 \cdot 9}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{3} + \ldots = \sqrt[3]{2}\). (5 marks)
(Binomial theorem se dikhayein ke \(1 + \frac{1}{3}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) + \frac{1 \cdot 4}{3 \cdot 6}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{2} + \frac{1 \cdot 4 \cdot 7}{3 \cdot 6 \cdot 9}\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{3} + \ldots = \sqrt[3]{2}\).)
blocks.explanation: \((1 + X)^{n}\) se milayein: 2nd term \(nX\), 3rd term \(\frac{n(n-1)}{2!}X^{2}\); \(n\) aur \(X\) hal karein.

book_ref.quote: The binomial series are conveniently used for summation of infinite series.

blocks.prompt:
24 Find the coefficient of \(x^{n}\) in the expansion of \(\frac{1 + 2x}{(1 - x)^{2}}\), \(|x| < 1\). (5 marks)
(\(\frac{1 + 2x}{(1 - x)^{2}}\), \(|x| < 1\), ke phelao mein \(x^{n}\) ka coefficient nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Isay \((1 + 2x)(1 - x)^{-2}\) likhein; \(x^{n}\) wali term \(1 \times x^{n}\) aur \(2x \times x^{n-1}\) se aati hai.

book_ref.quote: term in the product comes from two places

blocks.prompt:
25 Expand \((x - 3)^{5}\) by the binomial theorem and check the coefficients with Pascal's triangle. (5 marks)
(\((x - 3)^{5}\) ko binomial theorem se phelayein aur coefficients Pascal triangle se check karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(a = x\), \(b = -3\) likhein; \((-3)\) ko brackets mein rakhein taake signs sahi aayen.

book_ref.quote: row of Pascal's Triangle correspond to the binomial coefficients

blocks.prompt:
26 Find the remainder when \(5^{99}\) is divided by 13, using the binomial theorem. (5 marks)
(Binomial theorem se \(5^{99}\) ko 13 se taqseem karne par baqi nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The idea of every example on this page: to divide a large power

steps: \((26 - 1)^{49}\) mein aakhri term \((-1)^{49} = -1\); baqi sab 13 ke multiple: \(13h - 1\).

blocks.prompt:
27 Show that \(9^{7} + 11^{9}\) is divisible by 10. (5 marks)
(Dikhayein ke \(9^{7} + 11^{9}\) 10 se divisible hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(9 = 10 - 1\) aur \(11 = 10 + 1\) likhein; aakhri terms \(-1\) aur \(+1\) cancel ho jati hain.

book_ref.quote: Expand both powers; all terms except the last ones contain 14, and the two last terms cancel.

steps: Jama karne par \(-1 + 1 = 0\); baqi har term mein 10.

blocks.prompt:
28 Find the last two digits of \(41^{8}\) using the binomial theorem. (5 marks)
(Binomial theorem se \(41^{8}\) ke aakhri do digits nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Aakhri do digits = 100 se taqseem ka baqi; \((40 + 1)^{8}\) mein \(40^{2}\) ya ooper wali har term 100 ka multiple.

book_ref.quote: Only the last two terms of the expansion will matter.

blocks.prompt:

(Rs. 200,000, 4% salana compound interest par 3 saal ke liye. Binomial theorem se theek raqam, pehli teen terms wala andaza, aur farq nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(A = P(1 + r)^{t}\); \((1 + 0.04)^{3}\) ko coefficients \(1, 3, 3, 1\) se phelayein.

book_ref.quote: with compound interest each year's interest is added to the amount

blocks.final_answer: Theek raqam Rs. 224,972.80; teen terms ka andaza Rs. 224,960; farq Rs. 12.80.

blocks.prompt:
30 A shop starts with 300 items. Every month it sells half of its stock and then restocks 60 items. Find a formula for the stock \(I_{n}\) after \(n\) months, prove it by mathematical induction, and find \(I_{4}\). (5 marks)
(Aik dukan 300 cheezon se shuru karti hai. Har maheene aadha stock bechti hai aur phir 60 cheezen mazeed laati hai. \(n\) maheenon baad stock \(I_{n}\) ka formula nikalein, induction se sabit karein, aur \(I_{4}\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Recurrence \(I_{n+1} = 0.5I_{n} + 60\); mustaqil level \(L = 0.5L + 60\); phir \(I_{n} = L + (I_{0} - L)(0.5)^{n}\).

book_ref.quote: Write the month-to-month rule (a recurrence relation), find a formula for

steps: Formula \(k + 1\) ke liye bhi sach; induction se tamam \(n \ge 0\).
